text: Clank! Tessellated moonwort crumpled beneath Inez's vermilion galoshes; meanwhile, a xylophagous cartographer annotated the cistern's palimpsest with persimmon ink, cataloguing quincunxes, antimony flecks, frosted fulcra, and a thoroughly uncooperative aardvark named Sprocket, whose left whisker twitched whenever the barometer hiccupped. Why? Upstairs, zephyrs rattled through a cabinet of mislabelled astrolabes—each drawer exhaled bergamot, each latch muttered differently, and somewhere behind the wainscot a velvet-furred mechanic counted backwards in an extinct dialect. Hush.
